It supports NVMe 1.3, uses 3D NAND Flash, and is available in capacities up to 1TB. The SX6000 Lite is a strong upgrade option. SX6000 Lite PCIe Gen 3x4 M.2 2280 SSD IT'S TIME TO UPGRADE WITH PCIe Looking to replace your SATA SSD? If so, look no further than the SX6000 Lite PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 SSD. Supporting NVMe 1.3, equipped with 3D NAND Flash, and coming with up to 1TB capacity, the SX6000 Lite is a great upgrade choice. Goodbye SATA, Hello PCIe! Fast, Efficient, More Productive LDPC ECC for Improved Data Integrity Great for Desktops and Notebooks Goodbye SATA, Hello PCIe! A solid alternative to SATA for gamers, PC enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a move from SATA SSD to PCIe SSD. Up to 3x faster than SATA: read/write speeds of up to 1800/1200MB/s. NVMe 1.3 support. 3D NAND Flash: greater capacity, durability, and power efficiency. M.2 2280 form factor: works with desktops and notebooks on the latest Intel and AMD platforms. Fast, Efficient, More Productive With HMB (Host Memory Buffer) and SLC Caching, the SX6000 Lite boosts read/write speeds to as much as 1800/1200MB/s and provides random performance of up to 220K/200K IOPS. Whether booting, gaming, or moving large files, the SX6000 Lite handles it quickly and efficiently. LDPC ECC for Improved Data Integrity The SX6000 Lite uses LDPC (Low-Density Parity-Check) error-correcting code technology to detect and repair a broader range of data errors for more reliable transfers and a longer product lifespan.
